age_contradiction.description: Title has an explicit 'up to N years' bound and patient age exceeds it.

age_compatible.description: Title has an age bound and patient age is within it.

age_unknown.description: Title has an age bound but patient age is not extractable.

gender_condition_present.description: Title's topic keywords imply a required patient gender.

gender_contradiction.description: Title implies a gender and the patient's structured gender differs.

gender_unknown.description: Title implies a gender but patient gender is unknown, OR the title is pregnancy-specific (pregnancy is never confirmed by gender alone -- see special rule).

severity_match.description: Title and narrative both mention an explicit severity level and they agree.
severity_match.source: SEVERITY_TERMS lexical match on title_lemma vs narrative_lemma

severity_contradiction.description: Title and narrative both mention an explicit severity level and they disagree.

severity_unknown.description: Title specifies a severity level but narrative has no explicit severity marker.

condition_overlap.description: At least one non-generic title-lemma token appears in the narrative lemma.
condition_overlap.source: lexical set intersection, title_lemma vs narrative_lemma

condition_contradiction.description: A shared title/narrative condition token falls within a NEGATION_PATTERN window in the narrative.

condition_unknown.description: Title has condition tokens but none appear anywhere in the narrative.

contradiction_density.description: contradiction_count normalized by the number of checks actually applicable to this row (0 if none applicable).

protocol_negation_count.description: Alias of the existing C2 feature train_s2['negation_count'] (whole protocol_text). Not recomputed.

guideline_negation_count.description: NEGATION_PATTERN matches inside title_text -- new, title-side negation was never checked before H7's error analysis surfaced it (e.g. 'therapy NOT recommended' titles).

negation_count.description: Exact alias of protocol_negation_count, kept under this name because the H8 spec asks for it explicitly.

negated_mention_count.description: NEGATION_PATTERN matches inside narrative_text only (subset of protocol_text).

positive_mention_count.description: Count of shared title/narrative condition tokens minus negated_mention_count, floored at 0.

condition_present.description: Exact alias of condition_overlap (28.0), restated under the 29.0 naming the spec asks for.

contradiction_with_negation.description: Exact alias of condition_contradiction/condition_negated -- also reused as-is for the 32.0 interaction feature of the same name rather than recomputed.

icd_missing.description: No 'Код МКБ-10:' header found in protocol_text.

missing_field_count.description: Sum of the 6 missingness indicators above.

char_length.description: Exact alias of the existing C2 feature protocol_len -- reused, not recomputed.

token_length.description: Whitespace/regex token count of raw protocol_text.

section_count.description: Number of the 8 FIELD_PATTERNS headers present in protocol_text.

late_section_present.description: The 'Объективный статус:' header starts in the final third of protocol_text by character position.

complaints_token_count.description: Token count of the extracted Жалобы field text.

complaints_negation_count.description: NEGATION_PATTERN matches inside the Жалобы field only.

complaints_condition_count.description: Shared title-condition tokens found (lemmatized) inside the Жалобы field.

history_token_count.description: Token count of the extracted Анамнез field text.

history_negation_count.description: NEGATION_PATTERN matches inside the Анамнез field only.

history_condition_count.description: Shared title-condition tokens found inside the Анамнез field.

objective_token_count.description: Token count of the extracted Объективный статус field text.

objective_negation_count.description: NEGATION_PATTERN matches inside the Объективный статус field only.

objective_condition_count.description: Shared title-condition tokens found inside the Объективный статус field.

head_negation_count.description: NEGATION_PATTERN matches in the first 800 characters of protocol_text (counts only -- no raw text stored).

tail_negation_count.description: NEGATION_PATTERN matches in the last 800 characters of protocol_text.

head_condition_mentions.description: Shared title-condition tokens (lemmatized) found in the first 800 characters.

tail_condition_mentions.description: Shared title-condition tokens (lemmatized) found in the last 800 characters.

severity_with_negation.description: severity_contradiction AND protocol has any negation.

age_condition_conflict.description: age_contradiction AND condition_overlap -- age rules out the title even though the disease topic itself matches.

gender_condition_conflict.description: gender_contradiction AND condition_overlap. Constant 0 in this dataset (see 33.0 -- gender_contradiction itself is constant 0).

missing_with_long_protocol.description: missing_field_count > 0 AND char_length above the 75th percentile.
